## Summary

The fix for the outfit product list visual consistency issue has been implemented:

**Work Completed:**
- Added `useRef` to track the latest outfit state in `OutfitRecommendationCard`
- Added `useEffect` to update the ref whenever the outfit prop changes (triggered when ChatAssistant updates the message state with product replacements)
- Changed `onViewOutfit(outfit)` to `onViewOutfit(latestOutfitRef.current)` to ensure the latest outfit data (with product replacements) is passed when user clicks "View Outfit"
- Added loading state: disabled the "View Outfit" button while flat-lay is generating (`isGenerating`) to prevent users from viewing incomplete data
- Shows "กำลังโหลด..." text and spinner while generating

**Root Cause:**
The outfit prop could be stale when the user clicked "View Outfit" if flat-lay generation (and product replacement) was still in progress. The ref ensures we always pass the most current outfit data from the message state.

**Validation:**
- TypeScript compilation: Passed (no project errors)
- ESLint: Passed (no errors in modified file; pre-existing warnings in other files unrelated to this change)
- Build: Pre-existing issue with `/api/chat` route (encoder.json file missing) - unrelated to this change
